faq: Can you get my listing or account reinstated?

No one can promise that. The marketplace decides. We find the real cause, fix it and write an honest, well-organized response, which is the approach that works best. We never use tricks or fake documents.
Do you handle intellectual property complaints?
We can review the notice and your supply documents and prepare your reply. For legal disputes, a lawyer is the right person. We say clearly when a case is beyond a simple plan of action.
What do I need to send you?
A copy of the notice, the listings concerned and any invoices, supplier letters or test reports you have. If you add us to your account as a user, we can find details faster.
How fast should I act on a notice?
As soon as possible, because many notices have deadlines. Tell us the deadline in the order form. If it falls inside our delivery time, say so and we plan the work around it.
